details:
Smart Astronaut Health Monitor

A Smart Wearable Health Monitoring System

Our project is a smart wearable device designed to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. The device is worn on the upper arm and has a 3D design that demonstrates its shape and structure.

The device aims to measure three important health indicators: blood glucose, blood pressure, and body temperature.

It works through sensors that collect health data and send it to a connected smart application. The application displays and stores the readings, tracks health changes, and sends alerts when abnormal readings are detected.

The Problem:

Astronauts may experience health changes during space missions, and monitoring their health continuously can be challenging, especially during long missions far from Earth.

Our Solution:

We propose a wearable device connected to a smart application to help astronauts monitor their health and detect possible health problems early.

Project Benefits:

  • Continuous health monitoring.
  • Early detection of unusual health changes.
  • Easy access to health information.
  • Better support for astronauts' safety.

Our Main Goal:

To make space missions safer by providing astronauts with a smart and simple way to monitor their health.
